{
  "name": "prompt-forge",
  "version": "0.11.0",
  "description": "Spends your Claude Code tokens where they count: moves a new task into a fresh session (a new terminal window, or its own git worktree) instead of dragging a long conversation along, and runs small, clear tasks on Sonnet.",
  "author": {
    "name": "tomikng",
    "url": "https://github.com/tomikng"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/tomikng/prompt-forge",
  "repository": "https://github.com/tomikng/prompt-forge",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "cost",
    "tokens",
    "context",
    "model-routing",
    "worktree",
    "productivity"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "newSession": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Where a new task's session opens",
      "description": "auto: a tmux window, else a new terminal window, else /clear. superset: Superset terminals and workspaces when this session runs in a Superset workspace, else auto. tmux, window or clear: only that one (window uses terminalCommand when set), else /clear.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "superset",
        "tmux",
        "window",
        "clear"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "terminalCommand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Command that opens a terminal window",
      "description": "Optional. Used for new terminal windows instead of the system default; claude and your prompt are appended, and {dir} becomes the session's folder. Examples: ghostty --working-directory={dir} -e, kitty --directory {dir}, wezterm start --cwd {dir} --",
      "default": ""
    },
    "freshMinTokens": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Conversation size before a fresh session is offered (tokens)",
      "description": "Counted above the fixed system prompt and tools. Lower asks sooner; higher asks only in very long sessions.",
      "default": 30000,
      "min": 5000,
      "max": 500000
    }
  }
}
